instruction: Analyze cross-correlation and lag relationships between multiple time-series channels to discover lead-lag dependencies and synchronization patterns. Compute the normalized cross-correlation function (CCF) between pairs of channels across a range of positive and negative lags. Identify the lag of maximum correlation and test its statistical significance using confidence bounds derived from the standard error (1.96/sqrt(N)). Apply pre-whitening (fit an AR model to each channel and cross-correlate the residuals) to remove autocorrelation bias. Visualize cross-correlograms for all channel pairs and summarize the dominant lag structure in a lag matrix.
description: Compute cross-correlation functions between multiple time-series channels to identify lead-lag dependencies. Apply pre-whitening and significance testing for robust lag estimation.
keywords: cross-correlation, lag analysis, CCF, cross-correlogram, pre-whitening, lead-lag, multi-channel, time-series, python, statsmodels, numpy, synchronization
